programs.title: Europe From Above 5
programs.desc: The Old Continent seen from an extraordinary perspective.A bird's eye view will allow you to discover architectural treasures as well as natural gems.Europe will also be shown during different seasons.

programs.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Season 5
programs.desc: At the Critter Fixer clinic, doctors are fighting for the life of a critically ill dog and treating another animal that requires a complicated procedure to remove a record number of kidney stones.In the meantime, an injured wild turtle is given a chance to survive.Veterinarians also cannot ignore their regular patient, Bear the cat, who also needs help.The team also has to take care of a Belgian giant, a colorful conure parrot, a hen that can't lay an egg, and a pair of adorable kittens.

programs.title: Cheetahs Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programs.desc: Bertie travels to the Serengeti at the beginning of the wildebeest migration.His goal is to film the fastest animal on Earth.The traveler observes the mother with her young and the males cooperating during the hunt.
